data_use: Diagnostic reuse of the existing evaluation cohort, not an untouched validation set.
kappa_sampling: Full cohort: all 800 unique calibration humans, 2360 unique evaluation humans and 129800 machine texts. Human forwards are deduplicated across generators; task evaluation reuses each human for its corresponding generator/mechanism.
length_calibration: Retain the same full human calibration bank for every stratum; no conditional recalibration.
tail_events: U: p_plus <= alpha/2; L: p_minus <= alpha/2. Partition into U-only, L-only, both, neither.
averaging: Tail machine rates are task-macro; human false positives count each unique source once. Length-stratum machine power is text-pooled, AUROC macro over tasks with both classes in the bin; include coverage.
uncertainty: Human FPR Wilson 95% intervals; small length strata reported with counts. Kappa paired domain bootstrap on differences relative to 1.5, 10000 draws, seed 20260913.
kappa_calibration: Recompute upper weights and upper calibration ranks for every kappa. Reuse identical cached original uniform lower response, fixed for all settings. Recompute the default on the same forward passes.

scope_extension.reason: Initial runtime measurement permits full-cohort inference; expansion fixed before examining any sensitivity performance results. Parameter grid unchanged.
